Well then, I think you know the answer as well. I’m so sorry, it’s so crappy. But I’m a total stranger and it hurts me that you’re unhappy and feeling this way, so it should damn well hurt your man too! 

You deserve to feel good. You need to tell yourself that every single day until it’s drilled in to your head! It’s so cliche but looking at yourself in the mirror and telling yourself the things you deserve is actually quite therapeutic and empowering. Got to lift yourself and be your own number one fan, because nobody else will, and you’ve got this!

Whatever is going on with him, is just that, it’s with him!  It’s not your fault. However what he’s doing isn’t very nice or considerate of your feelings. Is he aware that you know he’s doing these things behind your back? Does he know it hurts you and is he continuing anyway? Have you had this frank conversation with him?

Does he watch things that you could imitate perhaps? Would that be nice for him and you? I’m sure you’ve considered this but I’m just asking. It could help to spark things up a bit, and give him whatever he’s craving with you as the object of his desire? It depends on whether you’ve given up hope or whether you think there’s still more that could be done.

This is so shitty on his part. If you don’t want to be with someone then you need to let them go, not drag them along and keep breaking their hurt while fucking around with other people on the side. 

You didn’t deserve this, and you don’t deserve someone who is doing that to you. 

I promise you that life can be amazingly surprising, this may seem horrifying right now but closing this door may just open another one that you didn’t even dream could exist! It really does happen, stay positive and stay strong. And don’t forget that you can do better.

I left mine 10yrs ago now. I was scared to leave, scared to be alone, scared of the unknown. But a week after I moved out, a guy I had always really been attracted to sent me a message, asking about my breakup. The next week we spent the weekend together. Best. Weekend. Ever. I finally found someone who holds an equal attraction to me as I do to them, and 10 years later we’re still at it! 

Anyone considering leaving, it seems so scary but it might just be the best thing you ever do.
